description: Labeled reflect-path scenarios for the Phase 6 NLI gate. Gold labels are used/ignored per memory. Categories target the documented precision boundaries of the lexical UsageDetector: generic short-content false positives, proper-noun coincidence, and paraphrase recall misses. Veto/contradiction/citation signals are excluded — they short-circuit before the overlap/NLI stage identically in both detectors.

categories.direct_usage: Answer restates the memory with shared vocabulary; both detectors should label used.
categories.paraphrase_usage: Answer uses the memory's fact reworded with synonyms; lexical overlap falls below threshold (recall miss for lexical).
categories.short_token_generic: Generic 3-5 token memories that pass the token floor and lexically overlap the answer ~100% but carry no substantive claim (precision miss for lexical).
categories.proper_noun_coincidence: Memory shares entity names with the answer but states a different, unused fact (precision miss for lexical).
categories.unused_distractor: Topically unrelated memories; both detectors should label ignored.
